description: An XML formatter that indents, minifies and checks a document in your browser. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

indent.description: Spaces per nesting level when formatting, or "tab" for one tab per level. Ignored by minify and validate. Defaults to 2.

keepComments.description: Keep <!-- --> comments when formatting; false drops them. Defaults to true.

mode.description: format re-indents it, one node per line; minify puts it on one line; validate only reports whether the tags nest and close, with the line of the first fault. None of them checks against a schema. Defaults to format.

xml.description: The XML document to work on.

name: xml_formatter
title: XML Formatter
